description: This file defines a stateless Orleans grain called TransactionCoordinatorGrain that implements transaction coordination logic for testing, including multi-grain operations, exception handling, and bit operations.

classes.name: TransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: A stateless Orleans grain used for coordinating transaction tests across multiple grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainSet
methods.description: Sets a new value for multiple grains concurrently.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a specified number to multiple grains concurrently.

methods.name: MultiGrainDouble
methods.description: Doubles the value of each grain by reading and adding the same value.

methods.name: OrphanCallTransaction
methods.description: Calls add on a grain without awaiting the result, simulating an orphaned transaction call.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a value to a grain and then throws an exception to abort transaction.

methods.name: MultiGrainAddAndThrow
methods.description: Performs adds on multiple grains, some of which throw exceptions, to test transaction abort.

methods.name: MultiGrainSetBit
methods.description: Sets a bit at a specified index across multiple grains.

methods.name: MultiGrainAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to grains and commits using a transaction committer.

methods.name: UpdateViolated
methods.description: Updates a grain's value, possibly to violate a transaction constraint.

methods.name: Double
methods.description: Doubles the value in a grain by fetching and adding.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByRWRW
methods.description: Performs repeated read and write operations across grains in a RWRW pattern.

methods.name: MultiGrainDoubleByWRWR
methods.description: Performs repeated write and read operations across grains in a WRWR pattern.
